      THE iconic HAVEN IN CITY CENTER JAKARTA

      Stay at Fairmont Jakarta, a luxury hotel in the city's prime location and enjoy iconic views of the city’s skyline from the 488 spacious rooms and suites. Enjoy convenient direct access to Plaza Senayan, one of the city’s most stylish shopping venues, Sentral Senayan Office Towers, and the sports complex - a curated ideal getaway in Jakarta.

      DISCOVER ELEGANCE IN THE HEART OF JAKARTA

      Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, Fairmont Jakarta provides a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication. Experience your own Fairmont Moments – when unparalleled service and hospitality are at the heart of every stay.

      Surround yourself with city vibes at Fairmont Jakarta in the heart of the city; a perfect place to enjoy all the best Jakarta has to offer.

      Enjoy the fresh, natural flavors of world-class cuisine at Jakarta’s finest Sunday brunch at Spectrum Restaurant.

      EXPLORE

      The rich flavors of Indonesian gastronomy in a luxurious setting in a Halal-certified restaurant in the heart of Jakara.

      The Fairmont Spa in Jakarta offers ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation. Enjoy a soothing massage continued with a delectable lunch at Spectrum Restaurant.

      Frequently Asked Questions

      Fairmont Jakarta is located at Jl. Asia Afrika No. 8, Gelora Bung Karno Senayan.

      The Fairmont Spa at Fairmont Jakarta is located on the 4th floor with 9 fully equipped treatment rooms, a steam room, a sauna, and an indoor jacuzzi.

      Fairmont Jakarta has a parking space building that can accommodate up to 745 vehicles.

      Yes, Fairmont Jakarta offers concierge services to assist with your needs, including arranging transportation, and providing information about local attractions.

      Yes, Fairmont Jakarta has the direct access tunnel to Plaza Senayan and Sentral Senayan Office Towers, open from 7 AM - 11.30 PM.

      Yes, the hotel features a halal-certified restaurant, 1945 Indonesian Restaurant, located on the 3rd floor.

      Yes, accessible rooms are available on the 6th floor and may be requested at the time of reservation. It also provides a selection of accessible washroom amenities.

      Cookies

      On the Fairmont websites, Accor and its partners wish to store or retrieve information on your device in order to :
      - operate the websites and provide you with the services you request (these cannot be rejected)
      - enhance and customize website functionalities
      - measure website audience and performance
      - profile your interests to provide you with relevant advertising
      - allow you to interact with social networks.

      You will be able to modify your choices at any time by clicking on the "Cookies" link at the bottom of the page.
